stem.text: Which plan diagram represents the tissues in a major vein?

A.alt: Plan diagram of a section with an outer outline, a double-line ring and a central double-line circle.

B.alt: Plan diagram of a section with an outer outline, an inner outline and a central double-line circle.

C.alt: Plan diagram of a section with an outer outline and an inner double-line outline offset from the centre.

D.alt: Plan diagram of a section with a double-line outer outline, an inner double-line outline and a notch on its left side.
